scope: Actual exec descriptor whitelist prerequisite for managed desktop application launch, not a desktop or input milestone
source_runtime_contract: integrations/puredarwin/chonkstep-darwin/darwin-spawn/runtime-probe/CONTRACT.md (bind final frozen hash in concrete packet)

required.F1_artifacts: Whole manifest hashes, unchanged passiveT2native50 KC/source patch, exact frozen C adapter and runtime fixture sources, pinned-SDK parent/child/exporter binaries, canonical8ff SystemB and retained runtime closure. Approved source and concrete packet bindings before execution.
required.F2_host_boundary: Frozen 0cf9 host/cce9 controller snapshots, exact child experiment and triple in actual before-start, no PDSerialHID/PDDARTSurvey/scheduler; exact bootstrap challenge plus one fixed launcher TX, sealed; no host HID input.
required.F3_foreground_status: Fresh nonce-bound BEGIN, enum0, exact child identity gate0, actual parent exit0 and exporter exit0 in STATUS, then RETURN/Darwin/arm64/25.5.0/END. Missing or nonzero status fails even if a JSON file says success.
required.F4_closed_records: Exactly result.json<=16384 and stdout/stderr/status<=256 each, closed indexed hex chunks/counts/SHA256, no missing/duplicate/foreign/corrupt/truncated record. Strict host decoder reconstructs all bytes; no live export or original file path inspection substitutes.
required.F5_real_spawn_and_ambient: Production-bound parent Darwin/arm64 check true; finite real soft FD limit4..65536 equals scan bound; both opened and SCM_RIGHTS-received ambient descriptors verified non-CLOEXEC and held through actual spawn. Real adapter called once; return0, stageFINISHED, child_created1 with positive owned PID, all setup/spawn/local cleanup errors0, duplicate_count4, requested_flags==observed_flags==0x400e.
required.F6_child_inventory: Actual child report matches nonce/owned PID/soft limit; all initial low0..3 open with CLOEXEC clear, functional selected pipe stdio and connected Unix stream fd3; bounded inventory sees zero extras in4..soft-1 and all failure bits/first errno zero. No claim about already-open descriptors above soft limit or Mach ports.
required.F7_roundtrip: Exact stdin IN nonce through EOF; exact stdout OUT nonce and stderr ERR nonce bytes; one canonical <=256B CHONKFD/1 RESULT frame matches all JSON report facts and owned PID/bound. No overflow, partial, extra or malformed byte; output EOF on all three.
required.F8_ownership_cleanup: Actual finite child wait terminal status0, reaped by sole owner, no ownership loss/error, no TERM/KILL, no unknown rights cleanup, no error records/overflow. Parent closes/syncs all owned endpoints/transcripts/final JSON; external exit0 is required because final-close failure cannot self-certify. Host synthetic classifier does not substitute actual child execution.
required.F9_capture_and_recovery: Capture finalized and bounded diagnostic steps complete; one native reset maximum, new verified Linux boot, incomplete latch absent and controller lock acquired/released afterward. Worker/status failures retained beside runtime facts; Linux recovery alone is not a whitelist pass.

not_claimed: Native input or raw key-by-key HID evidence
Darwin PTY-shell FD whitelist (separate DS4 prerequisite)
Atomic socket creation or a complete process sandbox
failure_policy: Preserve all failed/missing criteria; no same-candidate retry or weakened flags. No further boot without a concrete reviewed new candidate. Every test returns verified Linux.
runtime_budget: Existing bounded controller runtime; packet must reserve parent8s plus bounded TERM/KILL/reap and export margin after measured~78s bootstrap; no human action.
